challengesAndSolutions.challenge: Primary graphics workstation experienced a GPU frame-buffer lock 90 seconds before live countdown.
challengesAndSolutions.solution: Seamlessly toggled the video router clean-switch to the secondary mirrored Brainstorm engine without a dropped pixel.
challengesAndSolutions.impact: Broadcast started precisely on schedule with 100% graphics fidelity.

outcomes: Maintained unbroken 100% on-air compliance across over 180 consecutive live weekly draw episodes.
Awarded Certificate of Technical Excellence by Media Art Production (MAP).
improvementReflection: Transitioning to cloud-synchronized SRT backup streams further bolstered international streaming resilience.
